content: INSTRUCTIONS TO TENDERERS. Project: Construction of a 24,000 m2 pre-engineered steel warehouse and ancillary office building at Phnom Penh Special Economic Zone, Sangkat Kantaok, Khan Por Senchey, Phnom Penh, Kingdom of Cambodia. Employer: Meakara Industrial Holdings Co., Ltd. Consultant: Angkor Design Partnership Ltd. Tender Reference: MIH-PPSEZ-2026-014. These Instructions to Tenderers form part of the Tender Documents and shall be read in conjunction with the Conditions of Contract, the Employer's Requirements, the Technical Specifications, the Drawings and the Bill of Quantities.

2.1 The Tender Documents comprise: Instructions to Tenderers; Form of Tender and Appendix to Tender; Conditions of Contract (General and Particular); Employer's Requirements; Technical Specifications; Bill of Quantities; Drawings; and any Addenda issued in accordance with Clause 2.3. 2.2 Tenderers are expected to examine all instructions, forms, terms and specifications in the Tender Documents. Failure to furnish all information required by the Tender Documents, or submission of a tender not substantially responsive to the Tender Documents in every respect, will be at the Tenderer's risk and may result in rejection of the tender. 2.3 At any time prior to the deadline for submission, the Employer may amend the Tender Documents by issuing an Addendum. Each Addendum shall be numbered sequentially and shall form part of the Tender Documents. The Tenderer shall acknowledge receipt of each Addendum in writing, and shall confirm in the Form of Tender that the tender price includes the effect of all Addenda issued.

3.1 Tenders shall remain valid and open for acceptance for a period of one hundred and twenty (120) calendar days from the deadline for submission of tenders. A tender valid for a shorter period shall be rejected by the Employer as non-responsive. 3.2 In exceptional circumstances, prior to expiry of the tender validity period, the Employer may request that Tenderers extend the period of validity for a specified additional period. The request and the responses thereto shall be made in writing. A Tenderer may refuse the request without forfeiting its Tender Security.

4.1 The Tenderer shall furnish, as part of its tender, a Tender Security (bid bond) in the amount of two per cent (2%) of the tender price. 4.2 The Tender Security shall be issued by a commercial bank licensed by the National Bank of Cambodia, shall be in the form provided in Section 8 of the Tender Documents, and shall be denominated in United States Dollars. 4.3 The Tender Security shall remain valid for a period of twenty-eight (28) days beyond the expiry of the tender validity period. Any tender not accompanied by a substantially responsive Tender Security shall be rejected by the Employer as non-responsive. 4.4 The Tender Security of unsuccessful Tenderers will be returned within twenty-eight (28) days of the expiration of the tender validity or the signing of the Contract, whichever is earlier.

5.1 The Tenderer shall submit documentary evidence of its legal status, including a valid Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Ministry of Commerce, a valid Patent Tax Certificate, and a valid VAT registration certificate issued by the General Department of Taxation. 5.2 The Tenderer shall demonstrate an average annual construction turnover of not less than USD 8,000,000 over the last three (3) financial years, supported by audited financial statements for each of those years. 5.3 The Tenderer shall demonstrate successful completion, as main contractor, of at least two (2) projects of a similar nature and comparable scale within the last seven (7) years, each with a contract value of not less than USD 4,000,000. Certificates of completion signed by the respective employers shall be submitted as evidence. 5.4 The Tenderer shall demonstrate access to, or availability of, liquid assets or credit facilities of not less than USD 1,500,000, supported by a bank reference letter issued within the last ninety (90) days.

6.1 The Tenderer shall nominate key personnel for the Project and shall submit curricula vitae for each nominated person using the form provided in Section 7. 6.2 The nominated Project Manager shall hold a recognised degree in Civil or Structural Engineering and shall have not less than ten (10) years of experience in industrial construction, including at least three (3) years as Project Manager on pre-engineered steel building projects. 6.3 The nominated Site Safety Officer shall hold a current recognised occupational health and safety qualification and shall be present on Site at all times during working hours. 6.4 Key personnel shall not be substituted after award without the prior written consent of the Engineer.

section_label: 7. Pricing and the Bill of Quantities
content: 7.1 The Tenderer shall price every item in the Bill of Quantities. Any item left unpriced shall be deemed to have been included within the rates and prices of other items, and no additional payment shall be made in respect of it. 7.2 Rates and prices shall be quoted in United States Dollars and shall be deemed to be fixed for the duration of the Contract. No adjustment for fluctuation in the cost of labour, materials or plant shall be permitted. 7.3 The Tenderer shall complete the Summary of Tender Price and shall carry the total to the Form of Tender. In the event of a discrepancy between the amount in figures and the amount in words, the amount in words shall prevail. 7.4 Provisional Sums included in the Bill of Quantities shall be used in whole or in part at the direction of the Engineer in accordance with Sub-Clause 13.5 of the Conditions of Contract.

8.1 The tender shall be submitted in one (1) original and three (3) hard copies, together with one (1) complete electronic copy on USB media in searchable PDF format. 8.2 The Technical Proposal and the Price Proposal shall be submitted in separate sealed envelopes, each clearly marked and each bearing the Tender Reference. 8.3 Tenders shall be delivered to the address stated in the Appendix to Tender not later than 14:00 hours Cambodia time on the deadline date. Tenders received after the deadline shall be rejected unopened and returned to the Tenderer. 8.4 Each page of the Form of Tender, the Appendix to Tender and the priced Bill of Quantities shall be signed and stamped by a person duly authorised to bind the Tenderer, and a Power of Attorney evidencing that authority shall be submitted with the tender.

9.1 A prospective Tenderer requiring any clarification of the Tender Documents shall notify the Consultant in writing not later than fourteen (14) days before the deadline for submission of tenders. 9.2 The Consultant will respond in writing to any request for clarification received within the period stated in Sub-Clause 9.1, and will forward copies of its response, including a description of the enquiry but without identifying its source, to all prospective Tenderers who have obtained the Tender Documents. 9.3 No clarification given by any person other than the Consultant in writing shall be binding upon the Employer.

10.1 The successful Tenderer shall, within twenty-eight (28) days of the Letter of Acceptance, effect and maintain Contractor's All Risks insurance in the joint names of the Employer and the Contractor for not less than the Accepted Contract Amount plus fifteen per cent (15%). 10.2 The successful Tenderer shall effect and maintain Workmen's Compensation insurance and Third Party Liability insurance with a limit of indemnity of not less than USD 500,000 for any one occurrence, unlimited as to the number of occurrences. 10.3 The Tenderer shall submit with its tender a preliminary construction programme in bar chart form showing the sequence and duration of the principal activities, demonstrating completion of the Works within the Time for Completion of four hundred and twenty (420) days stated in the Appendix to Tender.
